entry.title: New: Resolution 332 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO THE ZONTA CLUB OF HILO FOUNDATION FOR ITS 2026 “AMELIA EARHART GIRLS IN ENGINEERING DAY” EVENT

Transfers $2,500 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 4)
